id.label: ID
id.help: The unique identifier for this collection.

schema.label: Schema
schema.help: The name of the schema that the collection objects conform to

format.label: Storage Format
format.help: How each object is stored on disk. JSON is the default. Markdown writes {id}.md with YAML frontmatter and the content property as the body, for content managed in a text editor or git. Fixed after creation: change it with tcms collection:convert.

singleton.label: Single Object Collection
singleton.help: This collection holds exactly one object. Clicking it opens that object directly for editing.

queueRebuildOnSave.label: Queue Rebuild Index on Save
queueRebuildOnSave.help: When enabled, saving objects will no longer trigger a rebuild of the index. This is useful for large collections.

url.label: Object Path
url.help: The url path to objects stored in this collection.

prettyUrl.label: Pretty URLs
prettyUrl.help: Use pretty URLs for linking building to objects in this collection.

category.label: Category
category.help: Add a category to organize the collections in the side panel

labelPlural.label: Plural Label
labelPlural.help: Custom plural term for collection items (e.g. 'Posts', 'Articles'). Defaults to 'Objects' if not set.

sortBy.label: Sort By
sortBy.help: The default property to sort the collection by in the collection view.

labelSingular.label: Singular Label
labelSingular.help: Custom singular term for collection items (e.g. 'Post', 'Article'). Defaults to 'Object' if not set.

publicOperations.label: Allow unauthenticated users to perform these operations on this collection

groups.label: File Access Groups
groups.help: Control who can download/stream this collection's protected files. Leave empty for public access. Add the 'default' group to allow any logged-in user, or pick specific groups to limit access to their members.

ownerProperty.label: Owner Property
ownerProperty.help: Property holding the owner's user id (a string, or a list for several owners). Non-admins then see and edit only their own objects.

ownerCollection.label: Owner Collection
ownerCollection.help: Only members of this auth collection can own objects here. Leave empty to accept any auth collection.

publicRegistration.label: Allow Public Registration
publicRegistration.help: Let visitors create their own account in this collection.

requireEmailVerification.label: Require Email Verification
requireEmailVerification.help: Registrants start inactive and must confirm their email before signing in.

registrationGroups.label: Registration Groups
registrationGroups.help: Access groups every registrant receives, added to the Public Registration Group from the auth settings.

mcp.help: Configure how this collection is exposed via the MCP server. Pro+ only.

formSettings.label: Object Form Settings
formSettings.help: Custom settings for the object creation/edit forms. Available options: helpStyle, helpOnHover, helpOnFocus, newActions, editActions, deleteActions

manualSort.label: Manual Sort Orders
manualSort.help: Define custom sort orders by property name.

properties.help: Override schema property attributes for this collection.
properties.label: Schema Overrides

customProperties.label: Object Specific Overrides
customProperties.help: Custom values for the form fields for specific objects.

totalObjects.label: Current Object Count
totalObjects.help: Current number of objects that have been created in this collection.

count.label: Total Objects Created
count.help: Total number of objects that have been created in this collection.

lastUpdated.label: Content Updated
lastUpdated.help: When content in this collection last changed — bumped by every object create, update, and delete. Says nothing about the collection's settings; see Settings Updated for that.

updated.label: Settings Updated
updated.help: When this collection's settings last changed (URL, MCP card, sitemap, access, schema overrides). Content changes never move it — sync uses it to tell which side has the newer configuration, and preserves it verbatim when settings arrive via sync.
